description: Adverse event report — supports 3 aggregation levels via `aggregationLevel` enum (per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 1 cross-actor extension): (1) 'individual-patient' = patient-reported AE intake with XChaCha20-Poly1305 encrypted patient identity + sealed-recipient to Council Lv6+ DIDs per ADR-2605181100; (2) 'aggregated-lot-window' = daily roll-up by pharma_post_market_surveillance for yakushi-side ingestion of mitate cross-actor signal; (3) 'aggregated-quarter-summary' = quarterly input to pharma_packaging label-warning data-driven update mechanism. When aggregationLevel != 'individual-patient', encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope + deviceFingerprintHash MUST be absent (G10 structural). Public aggregated narrative (no PII) is emitted by pharma_post_market_surveillance daily. G5 (public reporting) + G10 (patient identity non-traceable) + Charter Rider §2(c) (no resale to advertisers / insurers / employers). Per ADR-2605250500 §Decision 3 G5/G10 + ADR-2605250545 §Decision 6 + ADR-2605260215 §Decision 1 (mitate cross-actor extension).

lotAttestationUri.description: Back-reference to the lot the patient received. Allows full safety-signal investigation.

encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope.description: CID of XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelope. Plaintext contains patient_did, contact preference, and any patient-supplied context. Sealed-recipient = Council Lv6+ DIDs only. NEVER decryptable by ad / insurance / employer entities. Optional only when submission is via anonymous form.

deviceFingerprintHash.description: Optional for anonymous form submissions; SHA-256 of (device user-agent + locale + tz), used only for dedupe — never for re-identification.

severity.description: CIOMS Form III standardized severity scale.

onsetTimingMinutesAfterDose.description: Onset timing in minutes after dosing (integer; use 60 for 1 hour, 1440 for 24 hours).

narrative.description: Patient-authored description of the event. SHOULD NOT contain personally identifying information; intake validator scrubs obvious PII patterns before commit.

symptomCodes.description: MedDRA SOC / PT codes (LLT optional). Used for histogram aggregation.

reChallengePositive.description: If patient resumed the product after symptoms resolved, did symptoms recur?

aggregationLevel.description: Per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 1. When != 'individual-patient', encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope + deviceFingerprintHash MUST be absent (G10 structural enforcement). aggregatedPayload then carries the lot-window or quarterly summary stats.

aggregatedPayload.description: Required when aggregationLevel != 'individual-patient'. Mutually exclusive with encryptedPatientIdentityEnvelope.

yakushiProductDid.description: did:web:etzhayyim.com:yakushi:product:* — the yakushi-distributed product the aggregation pertains to.

lotIdHashRangeStart.description: SHA-256(lot_id) lower bound of the lot range covered. Cross-actor dedupe primary key per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 2.

patientCountDistinct.description: Distinct patient count over the window. Patient identity is NOT stored — only count. G10 structural.

medianOveruseDurationDays.description: Median days of overuse observed in the window. Threshold trigger for label-warning re-issue (>21 → label update per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 3).

medianDosesPerDayDecidoses.description: Median doses per day × 10 (decidoses; e.g. 35 = 3.5 doses/day). Per ADR-2605190900 no-float convention.

withdrawal8weekSuccessRatePpm.description: Withdrawal success rate at 8 weeks in parts-per-million (0..1_000_000 maps to 0.0..1.0). Threshold trigger for label-warning re-issue (<500000 = <0.50 → label update per ADR-2605260215 §Decision 3).

symptomMedDraSocCodes.description: MedDRA SOC codes observed in the window. Used for histogram aggregation only — no per-patient correlation.
